policy.ownership_transfer_rule: Any merge, split, support-only, defer, or retire decision must transfer every exact introduction and recycle role.
policy.recycling_rule: Every exact item needs a named introduction and a distinct later fresh retrieval before or at the A1 exit probe.
policy.mastery_rule: Mastery uses a fresh task, construct-aligned critical failures, no answer-revealing model, and a delayed probe.
policy.exit_rule: All seven exit dimensions and their protected capability anchors must survive final architecture decisions.
